front_content.text:
There is no denying that inconsistent annotation standards can distort cross-study comparisons.

There is no denying that... 表达什么语气？后面具体说了什么？

back_content.text: “不可否认……”。后面说，不一致的标注标准可能使不同研究之间的比较失真。
back_content.explanation: There is no denying that... 可换成 It is undeniable that...，加强说话人肯定的语气。具体判断在 that 后，其中 can 表示可能造成影响，并未声称每次必然失真。

After comparing all error logs, the reviewers could not help but question the reliability of the original coding protocol.

back_content.text: D，could not refrain from questioning：忍不住提出质疑。

front_content.text:
The revised guideline not only clarifies annotation boundaries but also reduces inter-rater disagreement.

not only...but also... 连接哪两个动作？它们怎样与主语搭配？

back_content.explanation: 两个并列部分都作谓语：指南既说明标注界限，也减少评分者分歧。guideline 是单数，所以 clarifies、reduces 都用第三人称单数，并共同接在这个主语后。
